validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: confirmed via 2 independent sources, both already cited on the sheet and re-verified live. (1) youm7.com (2019-05-26, 'كل ما تريد معرفته عن تنفيذ توسعات مشروعات خطوط نقل منتجات البترول بالصعيد') explicitly states, item 13: 'جارى حاليا استكمال إنشاء خط من جنوب حلوان حتى بنى هارون بطول 36 كم' ('a 36 km line from South Helwan to Bani Haroun is currently being completed') -- this names BOTH endpoints and the exact 36 km length verbatim, matching GEM precisely. (2) petro-news.com (PPC company profile, 'شركة أنابيب البترول - بترونيوز') separately lists a 'خط امتداد جنوب حلوان / بياض العرب / بنى هارون' (South Helwan/Bayad Al-Arab/Bani Haroun extension line) among its renewal/rehabilitation projects -- a second, independent naming of the same route (with an intermediate waypoint, Bayad Al-Arab, which does not conflict with GEM's endpoint-only convention). Both URLs re-verified live via url_verifier with the correct Arabic spelling variant 'بنى هارون' (the sheet's harvested citation pool used 'بني هارون' with a different final-yaa, which is why an initial verifier pass on that exact string failed -- confirmed as an orthographic variant, not a missing reference, by fetching the page directly). CLASSIFICATION: PipelineType='transmission' and Fuel='Oil products (only)' are both consistent -- this is one segment of a documented multi-segment Upper Egypt oil-products trunk chain (El-Tebbin->South Helwan->Bani Haroun->Beni Suef->Minya->Asyut) that the youm7 article lays out end to end; the neighboring segments in that chain correspond to other GEM rows (P7335 El-Tibeen-South Helwan ~87km vs article's 86km, P7320 Beni Suef-El Minya, etc.), so P7343 is a distinct, non-overlapping segment, not a double count. DUPLICATE: checked against the full 46-row roster -- no other row shares this name or these endpoints; not a duplicate. SPEC: Length 36.00 km is an exact verbatim match to the youm7 source, high confidence. StartLocation (Helwan, Cairo governorate) and EndLocation (Bani Haroun, Beni Suef governorate) both confirmed by both sources. Diameter and Capacity are genuinely not stated in either available source and are left blank rather than guessed. CAVEAT (why this is 'confirmed (caveat)' and not a clean pass): the youm7 source describes the line as 'currently being completed' / under construction as of May 2019 -- it does not say the line is finished or operating. GEM's Status='operating' is therefore an inference bridging a ~7 year gap (2019 article to 2026 sheet update) with no source in hand that post-dates 2019 and explicitly confirms completion/operation. Nothing found contradicts 'operating' either -- this is an evidentiary gap, not a disagreement -- so it does not rise to a 'concern', but it is worth noting for anyone who later finds a fresher source.

fills.researcher_notes: petro-news.com's PPC (Petroleum Pipelines Company, the operator named on GEM's wiki page) company profile lists 'الهيئة المصرية العامة للبترول' (Egyptian General Petroleum Corporation / EGPC) under its 'المساهمون' (Shareholders) section -- i.e. EGPC is PPC's state parent/shareholder, consistent with GEM's convention of attributing state-operated Egyptian pipeline assets to EGPC as owner. This is a single source (medium tier, independent=false per the ≥2-agreeing rubric) and it names EGPC's relationship to the OPERATING COMPANY rather than this specific pipeline by name, so it is offered as a reasonable but not airtight fill -- checked youm7's parallel article for a second source and it names neither EGPC nor PPC, so no second corroborating source was found for ownership specifically.

summary: P7343 (Helwan-Bani Haroun Oil Products Pipeline, 36 km): verdict confirmed (caveat) -- existence, route, length, classification all corroborated by 2 independent Arabic sources (youm7 names the exact 36 km South Helwan-Bani Haroun line verbatim; petro-news/PPC corroborates the route and EGPC's ownership stake); no duplicate or misclassification found against the 46-row roster. One caveat noted (not escalated to concern): 'operating' status rests on inference from a 2019 'under completion' article with no fresher confirming source. One fill staged: Owner [ref] (medium tier, single source). Diameter/Capacity remain correctly unfilled -- not stated anywhere found. Nothing UNRESOLVED that blocks the row.
